_note: Adjudications for oldest-end batch 05, Nov to Dec 2024. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

reviews.note: Generic anticipation of a move of God, no date and no marker.
Worth keeping as dated evidence: on 10 Dec 2024 he says he has not yet given his usual year-ahead word for 2025.
A conditional that makes any death among the audience attributable to not having listened.
The volcano is relocated to near Rome and softened to a conditional: if it goes off. He adds that they may have changed things by prayer, which retires the September 2023 telling without scoring it.
His own standard, offered unprompted: accuracy matters because it brings trust. Useful as the yardstick this whole database is built to apply.
One of the sharpest dates in the corpus: a named event, 9 February 2025, three weeks after the inauguration.
Also carries the Trump platform address, which belongs to trump-plague-address; the two are told as one scene here.
Dates the mechanism precisely: the balances shifted because the saints prayed in October 2024.
Left unsure: he says he does not know when, declines to quote dates, and offers 2026 or 2027 only as what they will try. The date is his inference, not the word.

A fulfilment assertion, and a checkable one: he claims a year-old word that the trials would run to late summer 2024 and would protect Trump by keeping him off the trail. Both halves can be tested against the actual calendar.
Kept for the template it supplies: partial change counts even without the full manifestation.
Late November 2024 and the good-year word is still being restated, with the year nearly over.
Adds the supernatural turnaround on 20 January, conditioned on the people praying and repenting.
Puts the end of the window at 2028 explicitly.
Same 2014 to 2021 framing as RlS3QooVBxg@3612, now backed with played headlines.
His stated method for a warning he does not want to voice: pray it in tongues instead of naming it. Relevant to why some warnings never appear as claims at all.
Named events and a bounded window, so this one is genuinely scoreable despite the prayer framing.
He is asking, not asserting. Dates his own uncertainty about a 2025 crash to 24 November 2024.
The frankest version so far, and it locates the error precisely: he assumes what the Spirit is saying and how fast.
He will not name the asset outright but describes it unmistakably. No date attached, which is what keeps it from being scoreable.
Ends with the general form of the escape clause: you do not always see everything the Lord tells you is coming.
